tools.name: building-energy_consumption-analyze
tools.description: Calculate interval consumption and tariff-based cost from supplied meter readings and rates. Missing tariffs are not invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/building-energy/consumption-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: building-energy_meter-reading-anomaly-detect
tools.description: Flag unusual daily usage against a baseline calculated from supplied intervals and explain the comparison method. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/building-energy/meter-reading-anomaly-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: building-energy_hvac-performance-analyze
tools.description: Compare supplied HVAC efficiency and temperature readings with rated values. Equipment is never controlled and performance is not invented. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/building-energy/hvac-performance-analyze. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: building-energy_baseline-calculate
tools.description: Calculate a mean daily-interval baseline and standard deviation from supplied meter readings for each meter. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/building-energy/baseline-calculate. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: building-energy_cost-variance-detect
tools.description: Compare billed costs with expected cost from supplied tariffs and quantities. Tariffs are never invented. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/building-energy/cost-variance-detect. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: building-energy_equipment-maintenance-priority
tools.description: Rank equipment using supplied service due dates, fault counts, efficiency, and runtime. Connected equipment is never controlled. Price $0.04 USDC. POST /api/v1/building-energy/equipment-maintenance-priority. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: building-energy_occupancy-compare
tools.description: Compare buildings only when supplied measurement periods and energy units are compatible, optionally normalizing by occupants. Price $0.05 USDC. POST /api/v1/building-energy/occupancy-compare. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.

tools.name: building-energy_efficiency-report
tools.description: Combine consumption, anomalies, HVAC flags, baselines, cost variance, maintenance priorities, and occupancy comparisons from supplied facility records. Price $0.12 USDC. POST /api/v1/building-energy/efficiency-report. An unpaid call returns the x402 payment terms and does not run.
